top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: AP Additional Caregiver Responsibilities - Number of Unrelated Children Never Exceeds 3 (26 TAC §742.307(3)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregiver had 9 unrelated children in her care on a regular basis for compensation.

top_violation_types.title: Provide Access to Children's Records - Licensing (26 TAC §744.601(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Child records were not available for review during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines (26 TAC §744.1315(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.

top_violation_types.title: Waiver/Variance - Comply w/ each condition while in effect (26 TAC §745.8311(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Management and the site director have not been following the conditions outlined by CCR for a waiver issued 11/22/2024.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record (26 TAC §746.1329(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Documentation showing training in the following topics were not available for review during the inspection:    - Recognizing and Reporting Suspected Abuse and Neglect of Children  - Transportation Safety Training
